title: HBM share of DRAM wafer input and bit supply, top-three suppliers, 2025-2027

units.wafer_share_pct: % of total DRAM wafer input (top-3 suppliers)
units.bit_share_pct: % of total DRAM bit supply (top-3 suppliers)

conventions: Values as published (approximate). 2025 end of year; 2026 end of year (estimate); 2027 forecast.

tf.cite: TrendForce press release, 2026-06-02, 'Tight DRAM Supply Gives Suppliers Greater Pricing Power in HBM, with HBM Contract Prices Expected to Surge Multiples Higher in 2027'
tf.locator: body text, paragraph after Rubin Ultra / Google TPU sentence

mic1.cite: Micron FQ2-25 earnings call prepared remarks

mic2.cite: Micron FQ1-26 earnings call prepared remarks

rows.loc: press release 2026-06-02, paragraph beginning 'TrendForce estimates that HBM wafer input...'
rows.note: Top-three suppliers. Wafer input 'by the end of' year; bit supply 'during the same period'.

rows.note: Top-three suppliers. Wafer input 'by the end of' year; bit supply 'during the same period'.

rows.loc: press release 2026-06-02, paragraph beginning 'TrendForce estimates that HBM wafer input...'
rows.note: Top-three suppliers. Wafer input 'by the end of' year; bit supply 'during the same period'. Forecast.

locators.hbm3e: mic1 p.6: 'HBM3E consumes three times the amount of silicon compared to D5 to produce the same number of bits'; mic2 p.5: '3-to-1 trade ratio with DDR5'
locators.hbm4e: mic1 p.6: trade ratio to increase with HBM4 and 'again with HBM4E when we expect it to exceed 4 to 1'. HBM4E >4:1 is in the Mar-2025 remarks only; the Dec-2025 p.5 text says only that the ratio 'only increases with future generations'.

micron_ratio.unc: exact (as published; Micron is an interested seller; HBM4E is an expectation)

extraction.method: Fetched the TrendForce press release HTML (curl), saved to fulltext/, text-extracted; printed numbers copied. Micron ratios read via pdftotext on the stated pages.

cross_check.resolved: HBM4E >4:1 locator: Mar-2025 p.6 only (A verified Dec-2025 p.5 says only "increases with future generations"); B concurs with Dec-2025 p.5 giving 3:1 only

caveats: Circularity (r2d M7): the 2.5-2.9 ratio implied by the shares is computed from them and must not be presented as independent confirmation of Micron's 3:1.
Wafer share is end-of-year; bit share is 'during the same period' (possibly annual); mixing bases makes the implied ratio loose.
2027 values are forecasts; 2026 is an estimate.
Shares cover the top three suppliers only.
Micron ratio is a seller statement; HBM4E >4:1 is an expectation.
